original_intent: When Decapod users select backend=local or backend=cloud, establish Dactyl ambient runtime variables and let Dactyl resolve the connection without changing its thin execution API; preserve local SQLite and leave hosted parity as a separate proof gate.
derived_intent: Implement the Decapod-owned route binding in core/dactyl.rs: local sets DATASTORE=sqlite and clears DATASTORE_TOKEN; cloud sets DATASTORE=neon with the opaque route and bearer; both open through dactyl_db::DatastoreRoute::from_env while forwarding StorageContext unchanged.
next_transitions: commit governed bundle, push branch, publish PR, then wait for hosted checks
governed validation then publish Decapod PR
active_boundaries: Decapod owns backend selection, route/token injection, and domain semantics; Dactyl owns env parsing and physical execution; Propodus owns hosted auth/tenant/schema/deployment behavior.
repo_scope: Decapod core Dactyl bridge, focused tests, living storage documentation, governed proof artifacts; no live service harness and no Dactyl or Propodus code change.
